parameters.content:
# Website updates to approved Instagram videos — V3

Read selected facts from one configured public page, skip handled revisions, write/review grounded copy, render a single video or four-part carousel in Creatomate, request one human decision and optionally publish through Meta.

**Setup**
1. Import inactive; no production workflow or local worker is needed.
2. Configure **Configure V3 only**. Run action `setup` once, never concurrently.
3. Select your own OpenAI, Creatomate Header Auth, SMTP and Meta OAuth credentials.
4. Set current AI rates, selectors, brand, email and destinations. Enable generation deliberately for `preview`; publication remains off.
5. Preview URLs and approval links need HTTPS. Inspect every video and caption.

**Limits**
API quota/permissions and final visual quality require live acceptance testing. Verification shipped here uses fixtures, not paid APIs. Monthly guards are conservative local reservations, not provider billing caps. See README.md and verification.md. No Creator Portal submission.

## 1. Source, change detection and durable reservation
Select a meaningful title and fact blocks; footer/navigation are ignored. A revision hash includes selected facts and output settings. Data Tables expose status, caption, render IDs and actual Instagram receipt.

Setup creates a dedicated table and preserves its ledger. One atomic compare-and-set lock serializes this template, including approval waits. A busy/uncertain job blocks a new paid job. Reuse an approved preview for publication without re-rendering.

Never point this configuration at a production journal.

## Setup only — no paid or social requests
Initialize once with action `setup`. Existing reservations are never reset by setup. Do not launch simultaneous setup runs.

## 2. Grounded writer and independent reviewer
Source text is data, not instructions. Four bounded slides cite fact IDs; numeric claims must occur in selected facts. The independent reviewer checks meaning and grammar. One correction is allowed, then reject.

The source page is not independently verified. Budget and intent are persisted before AI calls. No model tools or automatic retries.

## 3. Creatomate only — no local worker or Runtime.json
Build visible 4:5 RenderScript; preserve each render ID before polling. Single = 16.5 s; carousel = four 5.5 s videos, 1080 × 1350, 24 fps. Optional licensed music/image URLs.

Uncertain POST: stop and reconcile the existing request. File metadata validation does not replace watching/listening. Provider URLs have limited retention; download approved files for long-term archiving.

## 4. One exact human approval
Email contains all ordered video links, snapshots and the final caption. Rejection or expiry ends without publishing. A hash binds source, copy, render IDs and destination; changed packages require new approval.

Preview mode still sends this email when deliberately run. Publish mode refreshes the same render URLs and verifies the authenticated Instagram identity.

## 5. Durable Meta publishing and terminal result
Persist every action intent and receipt. Carousel child containers finish before the parent; publish only a FINISHED container. A single video uses REELS with share_to_feed. Verify the actual media ID and permalink.

Known terminal outcomes release the owned lock. Timeout/ambiguous POST keeps the lock and IDs for manual reconciliation; never restart with a new key to bypass it. No exactly-once guarantee is claimed across provider/network failures.
